newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha weakens for prompt barrels.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha weakens for prompt barrels.

text.p: NWE naphtha prices were a couple of dollars weaker on Thursday but August swaps numbers held their ground a little better, traders said.
While discussion on the physical markets was limited, July swaps values fell to around $175 a tonne cif NWE. August was quoted in a contango of around a dollar to July.
Dealers said the prompt market had been perceived as slightly overcooked and was also reacting to recent falls in gasoline prices which had made reforming unattractive.
"There is not that much interest for n+a material since the gasoline market collapsed," one refinery-based dealer said.
July gasoline swaps were assessed at around $181/$182 a tonne fob ARA by lunch time and prices were relatively flat out to September.
